title: Design System: Career Research Desk prototype

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Suppress animation and transition for reduced-motion preference.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: One clear next action on the active artifact; 44px minimum height.

components.name: Working Paper
components.description: Evidence-led content surface, flat at rest.

components.name: Current Navigation
components.description: Labeled destination with an explicit current-page state.

narrative.overview: A factual career workspace that lays out evidence, working materials, and the next decision; the assistant is contextual help rather than the only interface.
keyCharacteristics: A contents rail, current artifact, and contextual assistant on desktop.
Flat working papers with visible source definitions and unavailable states.
One selected teal action; optional photo handoff separate from core career work.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Unknown or suppressed values never share the low-value color; every color-coded value has a text label.

rules.name: The Artifact Leads Rule
rules.body: Specialist pages lead with the artifact; conversation remains contextual help.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal fields for passive grouping; shadow is reserved for transient layers.

dos: Label illustrative pay and distinguish occupational wages from observed advertised pay.
Keep reviewable edits and explicit stale, error, partial, and quota states.
Make the map's comparison data available in an accessible table.
donts: Do not present an unqualified personal salary number or overall career grade.
Do not make photos required for research or materials.
Do not inherit the portrait-first photo editor composition on career routes.
